text.p: Continental Airlines said Friday that it will offer non-stop flights from Houston to Guayaquil, Ecuador, starting January 9.
The non-stop flights, which last about five hours and 20 minutes, will be offered three times a week, the company said.
Separately, Continental said a new non-stop service to Ecuador out of Newark has been delayed until December 12.

Continental had planned to start daily non-stop flights out of Newark to Guayaquil via Panama City, Panama, on October 27. But the start of those flights have been pushed to December 12 because of a delay in getting governmental approvals, said Continental spokesman Dave Messing.
New non-stop flights from Houston to Ecuador leave Tuesdays, Thursdays and Sundays and return Wednesdays, Fridays and Mondays, Continental said.
